title: Strategy Inc 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K on April 13, 2026 disclosing ATM equity offering activity and Bitcoin purchase updates for the period April 6-12, 2026. The company sold 10,028,363 shares of STRC preferred stock for approximately $1.0 billion in net proceeds, which were used to acquire 13,927 additional Bitcoin at an average price of $71,902. Total Bitcoin holdings stand at 780,897 BTC with an aggregate purchase price of $59.02 billion.
key_points: Sold 10,028,363 shares of STRC (Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock) during April 6-12, 2026 for $1,001.3 million in net proceeds
Acquired 13,927 BTC using ATM proceeds during the same period at an average purchase price of $71,902
Total BTC holdings as of April 12, 2026: 780,897 BTC with aggregate purchase price of $59.02 billion and average price of $75,577
Available capacity for future issuance: $21.6 billion (STRC), $2.1 billion (STRK), $4.0 billion (STRD), $1.6 billion (STRF), $27.1 billion (MSTR)
On March 23, 2026, the company announced $21.0 billion increases to both STRC and MSTR offerings
Company operates a public dashboard at strategy.com for disclosure of securities prices and Bitcoin holdings
why_it_matters: This filing updates Strategy Inc's ongoing capital recycling program—converting ATM equity issuance proceeds into Bitcoin accumulation. Large-scale equity issuance (MSTR, STRC, etc.) and accompanying Bitcoin purchases can affect Bitcoin spot market dynamics and impact MSTR-related equity valuations. The ~$1 billion weekly Bitcoin purchase rate and $21 billion+ available capacity for future issuances demonstrate continued corporate Bitcoin adoption strategy with potential market implications.
